reason: Later full-TRAIN native/uniform comparison did not establish superiority; frozen-head pilot worsened VQA and calibration despite higher sensitivity
minimal_question: Estimate development-informed grouped performance of the fixed native B pipeline across the five existing outer folds
candidate_policy: Native B only, T/V/L/P off, original image and raw question, existing losses, fixed LAST epoch2; no inner hyperparameter search
comparison_limit: This minimal estimation design cannot establish architectural contributions or superiority to other candidates. Completed matched screens remain separate evidence.
seed_limit: One training seed; no claim of robustness across random initialization
roles: Retain existing train/model_val/calibration/outer manifests and component/detector metadata parity; model_val diagnostic only, no epoch selection
training_budget: Two complete TRAIN epochs per fold, batch4 accumulation4, same native fold0 optimizer/LR schedule rules; derive and bind exact fold schedules before release
fold0_reuse: Reuse verified native LAST1438 only if exact protocol/config/init/data/optimizer compatibility audit passes. Disclose that fold0 training and development inspection predate this amendment. Do not call the whole procedure prospectively untouched.
primary_endpoint: Raw canonical fracture balanced accuracy at threshold0.5; report per-fold and pooled once-per-image outer predictions
uncertainty: Component-group bootstrap of saved out-of-fold predictions; freeze algorithm/resample count/seed before outer inference. Explicitly conditional on fitted models; unknown patient grouping and training-seed variability not covered.
calibration: Separate reserved phase after checkpoint freeze. Exact estimator, regularization, fitting objective and failure rule still require an executable specification before any calibration labels/scores are used. Raw primary endpoint remains unchanged; no outer threshold fitting.
timing_limit: Conditional compute projection only, excludes per-fold gates, calibration, outer inference/replay, audit and machine variability; not a step3 completion ETA
runtime: Offline CPU8 float32 established quality reference. Hybrid visionMPS tiny-fixture qualification is not a full-fold runtime release.

Run applicable TRAIN-only routing/update/roundtrip gates for new folds
